compatibility_changes: Studio exposes shared selection and playhead control for agent-driven workflows through studio_select and studio_seek; selection is shared state and seek reports the actual landed position.
Studio render requests use the active composition as the default render target, with an explicit composition target taking precedence.
Composition activation is path-agnostic rather than limited to a compositions/ directory convention.
Studio save/render failure reporting preserves operation, file/composition, HTTP status when available, and timestamp for diagnosis and grouping.
HyperFrames v0.8.20 documents corrected Studio save-failure telemetry and v0.8.19 introduced active-composition export behavior; reCast mirrors the compatibility surfaces independently.
policy: Track documented behavior and compatibility surfaces; do not copy upstream implementation code.
